title: @reviewer
text:
API audit for release/2.4 is done. Two changes are breaking for clients that pinned the 2.3 schema:

1. `Session.lastActive` is now an RFC 3339 string instead of a Unix timestamp. Every client that sorts by it needs the new parser; the dashboard already has it, the CLI does not.
2. The `/api/v1/queue` response wraps items in `{items: [...]}`. Old clients that read the top-level array will see an empty queue rather than an error.

Everything else is additive. I would hold the tag until the CLI parser lands, and I can write that patch if you want it.

title: @reviewer
text: Patch is up as a branch: the CLI reads `lastActive` as RFC 3339 first and falls back to a Unix number for one release, with a test for each form and one for a malformed value. I also found that `agenthail list --json` re-emits the field it parsed, so scripts that read the JSON keep seeing the number until they upgrade; I left that as is and noted it in the changelog. Ready for your review whenever you are.
